script:
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --query view=main --expect 200 --check app eq qa-backend --check method eq GET --check path eq /echo \
  --check query.view eq main --check cookie_forwarded eq false --save F29.proxy-get/get
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/assets/app.js --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --expect 200 --check path eq /assets/app.js
test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --noproxy '*' -I -H "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/echo")" = 200
OPT=$(curl -s --noproxy '*' -X OPTIONS -H "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/echo")
grep -q '"method": "OPTIONS"' <<<"$OPT"
test "$(curl -s --noproxy '*' -X OPTIONS -H "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" -H "Origin: $S" \
  -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' "$S<redacted:session-cookie>/echo")" = OK
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/session --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$TOKEN" \
  --expect 200 --check path eq /session
